svg.title: tdm-dash · enclosure, 1:2
svg.text: github.com/frascella-dev/tdm-dash · generated by hardware/drawings/generate.py from hardware/enclosure/enclosure.scad, do not edit by hand
rider side · buttons 2× Ø12.2: SET left, MODE right
bike side · mount plate on the pod lugs · 2× M6 studs into the original grommets
seen from below, rider side at the top
Print at 100 % (actual size): this bar measures 50 mm
Display unit 213.8 × 130.8 × 14.5 mm: bezel and cover, M3 screws from the back. The pod behind it holds the
perfboard; the Pi Zero 2 W and the Kippah sit on the cover, inside the pod.
Bike mount: a 3 mm aluminum plate on the three lugs of the pod (M5 inserts) carries two M6 screws in place of the
studs of the original cluster, into its rubber grommets on the fairing stay (sheet dash-mount). Depth 68.6 mm with the
Two 12 mm IP67 buttons in the wings, their bodies in the cups of the cover.
Orange values are [TO VERIFY] before printing (chapter 07): display thickness, board heights that set the pod depth,
button bodies, the studs of the bike.
